data.offering_description: Sells nutrition, weight management, energy and sports, and personal care products worldwide. Products are sold mainly through independent distributors who buy them for personal use and resale, and the company manufactures most of its products itself.

data.primary_services: nutrition clubs; weight-management coaching; distributor training

data.customer_segment: B2C: individual consumers buying for personal use, including independent distributors who buy products for themselves

data.end_markets: nutrition and weight management; sports and fitness; personal care

data.revenue_model: product sales: nutritional, weight-management and personal care products sold to distributors and consumers; other: membership and sales aid fees paid by distributors

data.value_chain_position: OEM / manufacturer: makes its nutrition and personal care products in its own facilities, sold to distributors and consumers; brand owner: designs and markets its own brands, sold through its distributor network

data.geography_served: global: sells in many countries across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America

data.regulatory_exposure: medium: dietary supplement and food labeling rules from FDA and FTC, plus multi-level marketing and advertising rules

P1.1.text: We are Changing Lives with Good Energy! | BellRing Brands

P1.3.text: Premier Protein brings joy to the health journey with ready-to-drink protein shakes and powders that combine high-quality protein with amazing taste. The brand is sold in multiple countries and leads the category in flavor innovation.

P1.4.text: Dymatize is on a mission to become the global leader in performance nutrition by using science to unlock human potential. The brand offers category-leading formulas with a core focus in protein, strength and muscle recovery.

P1.5.text: A revered icon of sports nutrition, PowerBar helps athletes at all levels perform at their best. Today, the PowerBar brand is sold in over 35 international markets with a primary concentration in Europe, where it continues to be a go-to source of nutrition among elite athletes and fitness enthusiasts.
